conclusion.zero_run_rule: The HRC zero-run preorder representation can admit multiple mathematically valid global baselines. Choosing the smallest valid baseline can flatten genuine parent/child chains.
conclusion.dsc_code110_policy: Use DSC MODELS->MODELS relation code 110 only to score/select among already-valid HRC baselines. Change the standalone default only for a unique strict improvement; never post-hoc reparent individual nodes from code 110.
conclusion.result: After baseline disambiguation there are no known cases where a mapped HRC parent disagrees with DSC code 110. The two residual roots are mapping-continuity cases caused by non-model class-0/nonzero helper records in the HRC stream.

residual_roots.post_class0_filter_result: torus9 naturally becomes depth-14 child of smerge44; hierarchy mapping reaches 356/356 matching constraints
both cantilevers naturally become children of their preceding lfin model; full scene reconstruction succeeds at reduced tessellation with 64 nodes, 20 meshes, 20 primitives, 6 materials, 3 images
